The Trump Admin & Congressional GOP tried to dismantle & sabotage the Affordable Care Act.

Last year, @POTUS & Congressional Democrats boosted the ACA when we passed the #AmericanRescuePlan. Now a record number of people have quality, affordable coverage.
https://t.co/2wxq36MyGb

A record-breaking 14.5M people signed up for coverage under the Affordable Care Act. Instead of sabotaging the ACA like the GOP did in the Trump years, @POTUS & Democrats in Congress passed the #AmericanRescuePlan to make health care more affordable.
https://t.co/7dAVTIaYwb

Over the past decade, Democrats have helped millions of Americans get high-quality health care by expanding access to affordable coverage. Despite the progress we’ve made in lowering costs & expanding access, many Americans are still struggling to afford the care they need.

Exactly 12 years ago, President Obama signed the Affordable Care Act into law, protecting millions of Americans with pre-existing conditions and expanding access to medical coverage.

Today, the ACA continues to fulfill the promise that health care is a right, not a privilege. https://t.co/k4sPZ3kMIm

This is good news for millions of families that haven't been able to get the tax credits they need to purchase affordable health coverage. By improving the ACA, the Administration is continuing to stand up for Americans and expand access to affordable health care. #ProtectOurCare

By opposing our Inflation Reduction Act, Republicans voted against lower prescription drug prices and lower health insurance premiums.

Democrats and @POTUS stood up to Big Pharma and special interests and enacted the law anyway. #PeopleOverPolitics.

Reminder that open enrollment is underway! Head over to https://t.co/aUuUw8GAEe to make sure you are covered for 2023. Thanks to the Inflation Reduction Act, coverage may be more affordable than ever! https://t.co/iUyvnaVVpu

As the Covid National Emergency period ends, automatic Medicaid renewals are drawing to a close. Events like the Enrollfest I attended today are an important resource for the community, so people can get information to keep coverage https://t.co/5ehGLKDjtx

Affordable, reliable health care coverage is available NOW at https://t.co/cKnlP6hghf. This year, 4 out of 5 Americans can find plans for less than $10 a month!
 
Mark your calendars! You have until January 15, 2024 to enroll in a plan that works for you. https://t.co/PrtciMEjsW

Affordable, reliable health care coverage is available NOW at https://t.co/cKnlP6hghf. This year, 4 out of 5 Americans can find plans for less than $10 a month!
 
TOMORROW is the deadline to enroll for 2024 in a plan that works for you. https://t.co/wUrmHomkB1

14 years ago, @POTUS44 signed the Affordable Care Act into law. Thanks to the ACA:
✅ Over 40 million people have gained health coverage.
✅ Young people can stay on their family insurance plan until age 26.
✅ 100 million Americans with pre-existing conditions are protected. https://t.co/xMMAZck7aJ

I convened a health care roundtable with providers and advocates to mark the 14th anniversary of the Affordable Care Act. 

40 million Americans have gained coverage through the law. 

We must push back on any attempts to weaken the law, or undermine access to care. https://t.co/Ow1Lekcl5K

Two years ago, Democrats enacted the #InflationReductionAct. The law is already helping America’s seniors and working families save 💸💸💸 on: 
💊 Prescription drugs
🩺 Health premiums
🌎 Energy prices, and much more
50 million people have gained health coverage since Democrats enacted the Affordable Care Act into law. As some would say, that's a big deal.

Open enrollment @HealthCareGov ends today.
 
However, Virginians can still get coverage for 2025 through January 22nd at https://t.co/CFTAPiHXCn

Virginians! 🚨

Today is the LAST day you can sign up for health coverage for 2025 through the Affordable Care Act. Head over to https://t.co/CFTAPiHXCn to get covered. 
https://t.co/uXqR9DrKIK

Donald Trump and Republicans want to cut Medicaid to fund tax cuts for the ultra-wealthy. 

Medicaid provides health coverage to 1.4 million people in Virginia. 

I held a roundtable with doctors and beneficiaries to discuss how we must protect access to health care and save Medicaid.

15 years ago, Democrats transformed health care when President Obama signed the Affordable Care Act. 
 
And we built on that progress. We secured Medicare Rx price negotiations, capped insulin costs & lowered premiums.
 
Now more people are covered than ever—and at a lower cost. https://t.co/LZZpLkiTIY
The nonpartisan Congressional Budget Office has confirmed the Republican budget scheme will strip health coverage and benefits from millions of Americans.
I visited a transitional care hospital today in Norfolk to highlight the stakes for facility operators and patients if irresponsible Medicaid program cuts are enacted https://t.co/EaysJ7uYWT

Trump’s Big, Ugly Bill will kick 17 million people off their health insurance. 

And it threatens rural hospitals across the country. 

https://t.co/jMaFqrqxZz

Setting the record straight here:

1. NO ONE earning over $500,000 annually gets an ACA tax credit.

2. Undocumented immigrants are NOT eligible for ACA tax credits.

3. If Republicans do not pass an extension of ACA tax credits, premiums will rise by 114 percent next year.

A new report shows that health care premiums will more than double if Republicans allow the Affordable Care Act's tax credits to expire.

Democrats are fighting to open the government and lower health care costs.

Read the report here: https://t.co/heX1SIpB88 https://t.co/HLeKxPkb4C

Premiums will more than double for 20 million Americans due to Donald Trump and Congressional Republicans’ failure to extend the Affordable Care Act’s enhanced premium tax credits. https://t.co/RcyuLORwec

Republicans have an ongoing campaign to dismantle Social Security and Medicare, oppose universal health care coverage, and support diverting funding from public education. This resolution only furthers that campaign.
